description: Shared Spark runtime configuration — defines Python/R libraries, Spark properties, and compute pool settings. Changes are staged first, then published. Attach to notebooks and Spark job definitions to control their execution environment.
notes: Changes are staged first, then published as separate step
Publish is fire-and-forget: POST .../staging/publish with empty body
Live-pool pre-hydration: update staging compute with --live-pool-support Enabled plus --max-clusters-to-hydrate, --cluster-idle-timeout, and --live-pool-lifespan; publish before workloads use it
The instancePool.maxClustersToHydrateLimit response field is the capacity-computed upper bound for --max-clusters-to-hydrate
--clear-live-pool-settings sends customLivePoolSettings:null, removing hydration settings while retaining support state unless --live-pool-support is also supplied
Library upload: POST .../staging/libraries/{libraryName} with octet-stream body
Cancel publish available if publish is in progress
related_commands: fabio environment update-staging-spark-compute --workspace <WS> --id <ID> --live-pool-support Enabled --max-clusters-to-hydrate 4 --cluster-idle-timeout PT20M --live-pool-lifespan PT1H
